title: Table Style Library (Tables)

scenarios.title: Table Style Library applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Table Style Library (BtnTableBranding) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnTableBranding deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the dialog-free apply of the constructed style paints the header row blue (OLE 16711680) with Arial 14 pt bold white text and the body rows light gray (OLE 15790320) with Times New Roman 11 pt, keeps all texts, the 300x150 pt geometry at 40/40 and every row at 50 pt (RowHeight unset), reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the dialog-free apply of the constructed style paints the header row blue (OLE 16711680) with Arial 14 pt bold white text and the body rows light gray (OLE 15790320) with Times New Roman 11 pt, keeps all texts, the 300x150 pt geometry at 40/40 and every row at 50 pt (RowHeight unset), reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
